title: Compress, last area and a ruler
items: Compress images: smaller PNGs on copy and save, and pasting keeps the savings
Capture last area: reopen or instantly copy the area you captured last
macOS: a Dock icon while Settings is open, and a frosted glass app icon

title: Polish and a new look
items: New snapping-hand icon, with Liquid Glass on macOS 26
Quick area capture: copied the moment you let go
Full-screen captures get your default background too
Editor zoom: ⌘ + scroll or pinch, hold Space to pan
More to tune: step outline and shadow, dim color
Shortcuts held by another app come back on their own
Smaller installers; on Windows, sharper text, instant capture mode and a preview that stays on top

title: First public beta
items: Capture an area or the full screen, from a hotkey or the menu bar
Arrows, shapes, highlighter, text, numbered steps and blur
Gradient and color backgrounds with padding, corners and shadow
Floating preview, pins and a history of recent captures
Every tool, shortcut and theme in Settings
